_purpose: Machine-checkable boundary between LIVE conversational Workday path tests (protect) and DELETED autonomous-resident tests (safe-to-cut / restore-on-restore). Future test-estate cut subtasks must not touch PROTECT entries without operator sign-off.

protect.reason: Covers the agent-side message-poll endpoint (GET /api/agent/projects/{id}/messages) — the inbound operator-to-agent channel for the conversational Workday session. Removing this leaves zero test coverage on the agent message delivery contract.

Covers the admin-side conversational-session endpoints (GET /api/admin/projects/{id}/strategic-session and /strategic-conversation) and the session-snapshot sanitization logic. The listed test_ids are the session/conversation-specific ones; other tests in the file cover orthogonal surfaces and may be pruned independently.

Covers the operator message-create endpoint (POST /api/admin/projects/{id}/strategic-session/messages), session settings persistence, and workbench-state session_started_at decay — all live conversational-Workday contracts.
Covers the agent-side message-create and message-fetch endpoints used during a conversational Workday session (POST and GET under /api/agent/projects/{id}/strategic/*).

test_operator_workbench_current_state_contract_surfaces validates the strategic_session surface on the workbench event contract; losing it would allow silent drift in the admin-UI data contract for conversational state.

deleted_frontend.reason: Covered the StrategicSessionControl component — the operator UI for starting, stopping, and messaging into a conversational Workday session. Must be re-added when the component is restored.
Viewport snapshot test for StrategicSessionControl. Must be re-added with the component.
Covered the StrategicSessionEvents component — the live event feed for a conversational session. Must be re-added when the component is restored.
Covered the useStrategicSession hook — the primary React hook for conversational Workday session state management. Must be re-added when the hook is restored.
Covered the strategicSessionLive utility — live-streaming helpers for the conversational session. Must be re-added when the utility is restored.
Covered ToolResidentHandoffControls — UI for handing off control to the autonomous resident agent. The resident subsystem is fully removed and will not be restored; this test is permanently dead.
Viewport snapshot test for ToolResidentHandoffControls. Permanently dead — the resident subsystem is fully removed.
